caption:
Made a mistake? This is the way back to forgiveness

Allah says that whoever seeks His forgiveness after doing wrong will find Him All-Forgiving, Most Merciful. Start this Sunday by asking Him for forgiveness, before the day gets busy.

Surah An-Nisaa 4:110

Ask Allah for forgiveness before you check your phone.

#istighfar #forgiveness #surahnisa #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
